name: ⌘K Keyboard Symphony
summary: One oversized command palette over a blurred app; the query is the headline and 3D keycaps are struck on the kick drum.
look: Dark, blurred product behind a single bright centred palette with generous rows and shortcut hints. Oversized glossy keycaps sit at the bottom of the frame and press on the beat; coral marks fuzzy matches and the decision key.

motion.name: Beat-typed query
motion.how: one character per 1/8 note, caret blink 530 ms

motion.name: Result re-rank
motion.how: FLIP swap 0.25 s power3.out, new top row on the beat

motion.name: Keycap press
motion.how: translateY 10 px + shadow collapse in 80 ms on the kick, elastic release

story: Hook: ⌘K opens a palette listing 38 dashboards, most unchecked. Reveal: typing 'pulse' and striking ↵ expands the top row into the Acme Pulse lockup. Proof: inside the Pulse scope the anomaly row (checkout conversion −18% since 09:42 after deploy #2231) sits above 'Roll back deploy #2231', and the human strikes ⌥R. CTA: 'Every metric. Every minute.' above a palette whose selected row is Start free, with a coral ↵ key.
adapt: Fill the result list with your own objects and actions and use your product name as the scope chip; the last ↵ always triggers your CTA.

fit.risk: can read developer-only; keep queries short and result rows in plain language
